# Drone Escape

a\)

```{r,param_set_up,echo=T}
set.seed(2023)


inner_rad=0.25
outer_rad=1


# Initialize/Arrange object st they lie in outer circle/inner circle

J       =   50 # num trees/objects to avoid
o1      =   runif(J,-outer_rad,outer_rad)  # x-coordinates of objects
o2      =   runif(J,-outer_rad,outer_rad)  # y-coordinates of objects
objects =  cbind(o1,o2)





# Initialize xt such that it is in the starting position inside the inner circle

xt=matrix(cbind(runif(1,inner_rad**2,2*(inner_rad)**2),runif(1,inner_rad**2,2*(inner_rad)**2)),nrow=1,ncol=2)

delt    =  0.025            # How big are the steps you can take?

rad     =  0.05            # How close to an object before you crash?




game_status=function(xt,objects, rad,center=matrix(c(0,0),nrow=1,ncol=2),outer_rad=1)
{
  status    = 0
  J         = dim(objects)[1] # num objects/rows of tree matrix positions
  ones      = matrix(1,J,1) # col matrix/vector of ones J
  dists     = sqrt(rowSums((objects - ones%*%xt)^2)) # dist between xt/dron and tree
  min_dist  = min(dists) # take min to see if the drone has collided with at least any one of the trees
  
  # check outer point distance to determin win
  outer_circle_point_dist = sqrt(rowSums((center - xt)^2))
  
  #escape condition
  # distance btween drone and outer center >outer radius

  
  if(outer_circle_point_dist>outer_rad){
    status=+1
  }
  if((min_dist<rad)){
    status=-1
  }
  
  ret = list(status = status, closest = objects[which.min(dists),,drop =FALSE],min_dist = min_dist)
  return(ret)
}


game_status(xt,objects, rad,center=matrix(c(0,0),nrow=1,ncol=2),outer_rad=1)

```

```{r}
set.seed(2024)


# Initialize/Arrange object st they lie in outer circle/inner circle

J       =   50 # num trees/objects to avoid
o1      =   runif(J,outer_rad**2,2*(outer_rad)**2)  # x-coordinates of objects
o2      =   runif(J,outer_rad**2,2*(outer_rad)**2)  # y-coordinates of objects
objects =  cbind(o1,o2)





# Initialize xt such that it is in the starting position inside the inner circle



delt    =  0.025            # How big are the steps you can take?

rad     =  0.05  



# 3-3 NN
model = function(xt,theta,nodes)
{
  # Infer dimensions:
   N = dim(xt)[1] # input #features/cords
   p = dim(xt)[2] # length of weight vect
   q = 2 # dim[2] of output layer!
   dims = c(p,nodes,q)
  
   # Populate weight and bias matrices for neural net:
   index = 1:(dims[1]*dims[2])
   W1    = matrix(theta[index],dims[1],dims[2])
   index = max(index)+1:(dims[2]*dims[3])
   W2    = matrix(theta[index],dims[2],dims[3])
   #index = max(index)+1:(dims[3]*dims[4])
   #W3    = matrix(theta[index],dims[3],dims[4])

   index = max(index)+1:(dims[2])
   b1    = matrix(theta[index],dims[2],1)
   index = max(index)+1:(dims[3])
   # b2    = matrix(theta[index],dims[3],1)
   # index = max(index)+1:(dims[4])
   b2    = matrix(theta[index],dims[3],1)

   ones    = matrix(1,N,1)
   a0      = t(xt)
   
   # Evaluate the updating equation in matrix form
   a1 = tanh(t(W1)%*%a0+b1%*%t(ones)) # hidden layer 1
   a2 = tanh(t(W2)%*%a1+b2%*%t(ones)) # output layer
   #a2 = tanh(t(W3)%*%a1+b2%*%t(ones)) 

   # Return a list of relevant objects:
   return(list(a2 = matrix(a2,ncol=2,nrow=1) )) # output layer pred
   #return(list(a1=a1))
}

p     = 2
q     = 2
nodes = 2
npars = p*nodes+nodes*q+nodes+q # total num param
theta_rand = runif(npars,-1,1)
res_net = model(xt,runif(npars,-1,1),nodes);res_net


plot_game = function(xt,objects,rad,center=matrix(c(0,0),nrow=1,ncol=2), inner_rad,outer_rad)
{
  plot(NULL, type ='n', col = 'darkgreen',xlim=c(-2,2),ylim=c(-2,2))
       
  # plot inner and outer circles
  
  theta = seq(0, 2 * pi, length.out = 200)

  x_inner = center[1] + inner_rad * cos(theta)
  y_inner = center[2] + inner_rad * sin(theta)


  x_outer = center[1] + outer_rad * cos(theta)
  y_outer = center[2] + outer_rad * sin(theta)

  
  lines(x_outer, y_outer, col = "purple", lwd = 2)
  lines(x_inner, y_inner, col = "blue", lwd = 2)
  abline(h = 0, v = 0, col = "gray", lty = 2)
  
  points(xt[,2]~xt[,1],pch = 9,col = 'black')
  points(objects[,1],objects[,2],pch=19,col='green')
  # abline(v = c(-1,1), lty = 3,col = 'black',lwd = 2)
  # abline(h = c(-1,1), lty = 3,col = c('black','black'), lwd = 2)
}

#plot_game(xt,objects,rad,inner_rad=inner_rad,outer_rad=outer_rad)



# play a game func


play_a_game = function(x0,delt,objects,rad,theta,plt = FALSE,trace = FALSE,nodes)
{
  k           =   1  # Count how many steps
  xt          =   x0 # Set the initial coordinate(s) for the drone.
  trajectory = matrix(0,2,100) # store the the postions that the drone takes through out the game/how it moves
  trajectory[,1] = x0

  # Check the game status:
  res_status  = game_status(xt,objects,rad)

  if(plt)
  {
  	plot_game(xt,objects,rad,c('red','black','green')[res_status$status+2])

  }
  while((res_status$status==0)&(k<100)) # single game=100 steps
  {
    k = k+1
    
    # Now, let the model update the position of the pieces:
    ct = model(xt,theta,nodes) #res_status$closest
    xt =  xt+ct*delt

    # Checkk the game status after the positions are updates:
    res_status  = game_status(xt,objects,rad)
    if(trace)
    {
    	trajectory[,k] = xt
    }
    if(plt)
    {
      plot_game(xt,objects,rad,inner_rad=inner_rad,outer_rad=outer_rad)
      
      plot_game(xt,objects,rad,c('red','black','green')[res_status$status+2])
title(main = paste0('Step/Iteration ',k))
#Sys.sleep(0.1)
    }
  }
  trajectory = trajectory[,1:k,drop = FALSE]
    if(trace)
  {
  	lines(trajectory[2,]~trajectory[1,],col = 'lightgrey')
  }
  return(list(k = k, status = res_status$status,xt= xt,trajectory = trajectory))
}

x0=xt
theta=theta_rand

play(xt,delt,objects,rad,theta,plt = TRUE,trace = TRUE)



# Obj func
play_T_games = function(theta,J,T_games=1) # This is our obj function!
{
	score = 0
	for(i in 1:T_games)
	{
    o1      =   runif(J,outer_rad**2,2*(outer_rad)**2)  # x-coordinates of objects
    o2      =   runif(J,outer_rad**2,2*(outer_rad)**2)  # y-coordinates of objects
  objects =  cbind(o1,o2)
  xt=matrix(cbind(runif(1,inner_rad**2,2*(inner_rad)**2),runif(1,inner_rad**2,2*(inner_rad)**2)),nrow=1,ncol=2)
   res_play = play(xt,delt,objects,rad,theta,plt = FALSE,trace = FALSE)
   score    = score+(res_play$status==+1) # number of times when we got to the other side
	}
  return(score/T_games)
}
play_T_games(theta_rand)



# Use GA function 

library('GA')
GA <- ga(type   = 'real-valued',
	      fitness = play_T_games, # used here to get the optimal theta
	      lower   = rep(-10,npars), # lower bound vector 
	      upper   = rep(+10,npars), # upper bound vect
	      popSize = 100,
	      maxiter = 100)

plot(GA)

theta_hat = GA@solution[1,] # note  @solution to get optimal theta
theta_hat
```
